**Area:** [Web, network & communication](../COVERAGE.md#web) · **Apple:** [Network](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/network) · **Issues:** [`area:web`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Aweb)

## How isim implements it

- **Passthrough:** host sockets, with the host's OpenSSL for TLS and isim's own mDNS. QUIC is a stub (the host's OpenSSL 3.0 has no QUIC).

## API

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Network framework `NWPathMonitor` (`pathUpdateHandler`, `currentPath`, `for await`) | ✅ | ≤17 | mirrors the host's connectivity (Wi-Fi/Ethernet), polled every 2 s; tested |
| Network framework `NWConnection`, `NWListener`, `NWEndpoint`, `NWParameters` (TCP, UDP) | ✅ | ≤17 | host sockets; states (`waiting` on refused/DNS failure), send/receive/receiveMessage, final messages, `currentPath` endpoints, UDP listener connections, TCP options. Tested (HelloConnections) |
| Network framework TLS (`NWProtocolTLS`, `sec_protocol_options` verify block, ALPN, TLS listeners, client certificates, DTLS) | ✅ | ≤17 | the host's OpenSSL: clients check the host's CA store and the host name, or the app's verify block decides with the peer's chain in `sec_trust_t` (`sec_trust_copy_ref`: a SecTrust with the SSL policy, for evaluation or pinning); ALPN, minimum/maximum version, negotiated version/ALPN metadata, `sec_protocol_metadata_access_peer_certificate_chain`; TLS listeners with a server identity (`sec_identity_create`, `sec_protocol_options_set_local_identity`), client certificates (challenge block, required by the server's verify block); DTLS 1.2 over UDP (connections and listeners). Tested (swift-network) |
| Network framework QUIC (`NWProtocolQUIC`, `NWParameters(quic:)`, `NWMultiplexGroup`) | 🧩 | ≤17 | stub: the types exist so apps compile, connections and multiplex groups fail with `ENOTSUP` (the host's OpenSSL 3.0 has no QUIC). Tested (fails as documented) |
| Network framework Bonjour (`NWListener.service`, `NWBrowser`, `.service` endpoints, TXT records) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: apps of this isim device find each other at once in a local registry (`$ISIM_DATA/Library/isim/Bonjour`), and services are advertised and browsed over multicast DNS on the host's network (PTR/SRV/TXT/A, announcements and goodbyes, legacy unicast queries; one responder per app, sharing port 5353 with the host's), so other machines and isim devices see them; `.service` endpoints resolve over mDNS. No name probing (a name already seen gets " (2)"). `ISIM_MDNS=0`: the local registry only. Tested (test_connections, test_connections_mdns against a Python mDNS peer) |
| Network framework `NWProtocolWebSocket`, `NWProtocolFramer`, `NWConnectionGroup` | ✅ | ≤17 | WebSocket client and server (handshake with additional headers / subprotocols / client request handler, text/binary/ping/pong/close messages, auto-reply ping, metadata); custom framers (`NWProtocolFramerImplementation`: start with a handshake, `parseInput`/`deliverInput`, `handleOutput`/`writeOutput`, `markReady`, message metadata) over TCP or TLS; `NWConnectionGroup` with `NWMulticastGroup` (UDP multicast: join, receive with the sender, send to the group or one member, reply, `extract`). Tested (swift-network NWProtocols) |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 17 and earlier) | ❌ | ≤17 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `nw_framer_start_result_t`, `nw_interface_radio_type_t`, `nw_ip_ecn_flag_t`, `nw_ip_local_address_preference_t`, `nw_ip_version_t`, `nw_link_quality_t`, `nw_multipath_service_t`, `nw_multipath_version_t`, `nw_parameters_attribution_t`, `nw_parameters_expired_dns_behavior_t`, `nw_path_unsatisfied_reason_t`, `nw_quic_stream_type_t`, `nw_service_class_t`, `nw_ws_close_code_t`, `nw_ws_opcode_t`, `nw_ws_response_status_t`, `nw_ws_version_t`, `OS_nw_advertise_descriptor`, `OS_nw_browse_descriptor`, `OS_nw_browse_result`, `OS_nw_browser`, `OS_nw_connection`, `OS_nw_connection_group`, `OS_nw_content_context`, `OS_nw_data_transfer_report`, `OS_nw_endpoint`, `OS_nw_error`, `OS_nw_establishment_report`, `OS_nw_ethernet_channel`, `OS_nw_framer`, `OS_nw_group_descriptor`, `OS_nw_interface`, `OS_nw_listener`, `OS_nw_object`, `OS_nw_parameters`, `OS_nw_path`, `OS_nw_path_monitor`, `OS_nw_privacy_context`, `OS_nw_protocol_definition`, `OS_nw_protocol_metadata`, `OS_nw_protocol_options`, `OS_nw_protocol_stack`, `OS_nw_proxy_config`, `OS_nw_relay_hop`, `OS_nw_resolution_report`, `OS_nw_resolver_config`, `OS_nw_txt_record`, `OS_nw_ws_request`, `OS_nw_ws_response`, `ProxyConfiguration` (50 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
